pr_title: Fixing testComplicatedBucketPath for avg bucket agg
pr_body:
The test was erroneously creating a test Lucene index reader directly. This means that sometimes the reader was wrapped as a Parallel (threaded) reader which we don't support yet. 

This commit cleans up the test and uses AggregatorTestCase#newIndexSearcher directly.

closes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/87155

issue_context.title: [CI] AvgBucketAggregatorTests testComplicatedBucketPath failing
issue_context.body:
ParallelCompositeReader is not a DirectoryReader
they both inherit from BaseCompositeReader
hence a class cast exception. The cast was there since 2015, the hierarchy is the same in v8 and v9. 
Maybe something changed in lucene logic that makes the cast unsafe now?

comments: This is because this test (written by me) uses the Lucene index reader DIRECTLY, and specifically asks for it to maybe be wrapped...We don't (yet) support the threaded reader, I should have used the AggregatorTestCase#newIndexSearcher method.

review_comments: Re-reading the test, I realized that none of these were necessary. Cleaning up.
This is the key change. I was using the newSearcher method from lucene tests which randomly wraps it as a parallel reader, which we don't support.
